processEdgesException.note: Process Edges is the sole broad external-effect architecture exception for Packaged Service Structure; it is construction input for root.BuildProcess and functional-test overrides, not a product service.

ownerRationales.authority: Desired/observed trigger instances, cursors/checkpoints, and Work Request generation from clocks or external observations.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Automation definitions, instance status, and cursor/checkpoint store owned by Automations.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Reconciles desired specs into long-running trigger instances with start/stop/join/restart policy.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Runtime (via Work commands), Work Admission, Operator Settings, transports commanding reconcile/list/control.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Trigger instance and cursor mutations stay inside Automations; Work admission is a cross-owner command.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Missed triggers, duplicate emissions, cursor recovery, cancellation, and downstream Work rejection are typed Automations facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Deterministic schedule ticks that command Work admission.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Schedule/jitter/expiry configuration and tick cursors under Automations store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Produces ticks under Reconciliation supervision; no independent daemon outside Automations.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations Reconciliation and Work Admission via Automations root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Shares Automations instance/cursor transaction; does not own Work content.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Invalid schedules and missed ticks surface as Automations status/recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Watch configured paths, preseed, debounce/coalesce, persist cursor, and command Work.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Watcher cursors and configured path subscriptions in Automations store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Long-running watch instances supervised by Reconciliation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations root consumers and Work Admission; moves filesystem ingest off Factory Runtime.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Cursor and subscription mutations are Automations-local; Work creation is a command.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Watcher restart and cursor recovery remain Automations failure/recovery policy.

ownerRationales.authority: Observe hosted systems, poll/restart/checkpoint, normalize observations, and command Work.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Hosted-source cursors/checkpoints and secrets resolution handles under Automations.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Polling/restart lifecycle owned by Automations, not Workers Hosted Runner.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations root and Work Admission; Workers retains only hosted Work execution.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Observation/cursor state is Automations-local; Work Requests cross the Work boundary.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Poll/restart and secret-resolution failures classify as Automations source faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Apply desired automation specs, construct instances, track status, and supervise lifecycle.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Desired/observed automation instance registry and status in Automations store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Owns start/stop/join/restart orchestration for trigger subservices.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations root command surface and trigger subservices.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Desired-spec application and instance status mutations are one Automations aggregate.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Restart policy and reconcile conflicts remain Automations recovery behavior.

ownerRationales.authority: Supervise polling commands/sources that emit canonical Work Requests.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Poller cursors/checkpoints under Automations store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Timeout/restart supervision under Reconciliation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations root and Work Admission.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Cursor and poller status are Automations-local; emitted Work crosses owners by command.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Timeout and parse failures remain Automations poller recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Owns Chat Session, target-episode, turn, attachment, control-intent, and Factory-target catalog authority, including validation, lifecycle transitions, idempotency, and the live session service implementation.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Process-local Chat Session state and its sequenced delivery metadata; Events owns the source-native stream records and Recordings owns the canonical durable Factory Event ledger.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Wire constructs the service once; session, turn, attachment, control, Factory-target binding, and response-bridge operations run through the Chat Sessions lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: ACP transport, Factory Sessions target execution, Events sequencing, Worker Sessions response bridging, and Chat Sessions-owned transport adapters.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Chat Session version guards serialize session-local mutations; Factory-target execution and event sequencing remain explicit cross-owner commands through published capabilities.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Typed validation, not-found, busy, conflict, transition, attachment-position, and retention-gap failures preserve the session boundary; retries converge through request identities and idempotent operations.

ownerRationales.authority: Owns the process-local source-native event stream: event identity, envelopes, append and source attachment, retained reads, cursors, subscriptions, retention gaps, and backpressure outcomes.
ownerRationales.stateStore: In-memory topic stores and subscription state; Recordings remains the canonical durable Factory Event ledger and replay source.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Wire constructs the stream service once; append, attach, retained-read, and subscription lifecycles are active for the process lifetime and close with the application.
ownerRationales.consumers: Chat Sessions sequencing, Worker Sessions publication, Factory Sessions response consumers, ACP transport composition, and Recordings event capture.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Topic append and subscription state are Events-local; Chat Sessions owns session sequencing and Recordings owns durable capture, so cross-owner handoffs use explicit event contracts.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Invalid identities, duplicate appends, source mismatches, retention gaps, and closed subscriptions return typed stream facts without moving durable history into Events.

ownerRationales.authority: Authored Factory aggregate catalog: validation, persistence, versioning, activation, and packaged installation.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Named Factory roots, authored layouts, .current-factory pointer, snapshots, and packaged assets.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: No autonomous background daemon; activation is request-driven through Factory Sessions.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions, System Bootstrap, Automations (trigger specs), transports, Wire construction.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Catalog/authoring/compilation/validation/snapshot/distribution share one Definition aggregate transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Malformed layouts, activation conflicts, and persistence failures remain Definition-owned typed facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Parse/render split authored layouts and atomically create/replace/flatten/expand one Factory aggregate.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Authored layout files under Definition-owned filesystem datastore.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Request-driven authoring operations; no independent daemon.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions root and Definition-owned transports.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Layout writes participate in the Definition aggregate transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Parse/render and layout conflicts are Definition authoring failures.

ownerRationales.authority: List/delete/resolve named/project/global Factories and atomically manage the current pointer.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Named Factory catalog and .current-factory pointer.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Catalog mutations are command-driven; no background reconciler.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions root, System Bootstrap, Factory Sessions activation.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Catalog and current-pointer updates are atomic within Definitions.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Missing/conflicting names and pointer races are Definition catalog failures.

ownerRationales.authority: Convert authored/canonical source into one normalized LoadedFactorySource without executing it.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Compiled effective definition artifacts derived from authored store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Compile on command; Runtime executes, Definitions does not.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions root and Runtime semantic-validation callers via root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Compilation outputs are Definition-owned; Runtime does not mutate authored store.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Compile/reference-resolution failures stay on the Definition boundary.

ownerRationales.authority: Built-in package catalog, packaged installation, and scaffold creation producing Factory aggregates.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Packaged Factory assets and installation outputs in Definition store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Install/scaffold commands; no marketplace lifecycle in this program.
ownerRationales.consumers: System Bootstrap, CLI/HTTP Definition adapters, Factory Definitions root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Installation writes the same Definition aggregate transactionally.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Install/scaffold failures roll back or report Definition distribution faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Definition-owned interpretation of authored Factory behavior at invocation time: decision envelopes, interpolation, output shaping, work-type selection, quorum lineage, work propagation, workstation execution limits, and TTS observability identity.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Stateless invocation-time policy derivations over authored worker, workstation, and packaged configuration.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Policy interpretation runs on command during worker and workstation invocation; no independent daemon.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions root, Factory Sessions invocation, and Workers dispatch consumers via Definitions root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Invocation policy does not mutate peer stores; interpretation outputs are Definition-owned values consumed at invocation.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Malformed authored policy and unsupported invocation contracts surface as Definition-owned rejection facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Capture detached snapshots and prepare/materialize bundled assets for export/import/replay use.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Editable/version snapshots and bundled portable assets.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Snapshot/export/import are request-driven operations.
ownerRationales.consumers: Recordings replay consumers via Definition compile/import root operations; Definition transports.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Snapshot materialization stays inside Definitions; Recordings owns replay plans.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Portability validation and materialization failures are Definition-owned.

ownerRationales.authority: Structural, topology, pre-persist, tool, and workstation compatibility validation policy.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Validation policy and diagnostics over Definition aggregate; may query Runtime root for orchestration semantics.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Validation runs on command before persist/activation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions root and authoring/activation callers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Validation does not mutate peer stores; persist remains Definition transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Validation diagnostics are Definition rejection facts, not Runtime failures.

ownerRationales.authority: Per-session orchestration, execution state, instance mechanics, dispatch planning, and checkpoints.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Runtime checkpoints, submission/result/dispatch buffers, and live instance state.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Owns run handle pause/resume/stop/replacement/recovery for one leased execution instance.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions (lease/start), Workers (dispatch), Work, Recordings (event candidates), Visualization (sanitized observations).
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Runtime instance and checkpoint mutations are Runtime-local; peer Work/Workers/Recordings interactions are commands/events.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Crash recovery uses Runtime checkpoints plus Recordings history; orchestration failures normalize at Runtime root.

ownerRationales.authority: Capture/load versioned execution checkpoints and restore orchestration state idempotently.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Runtime-owned checkpoint store coordinated with Recordings history ownership.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Recovery commands after durability decision; not an independent deployable yet.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Runtime root and Instance Host.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Checkpoint write/load is Runtime-local; canonical history remains Recordings.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Incompatible checkpoints and restore conflicts are Runtime recovery failures.

ownerRationales.authority: Convert enabled transitions into stable dispatch intents and accept correlated results.
ownerRationales.stateStore: In-flight dispatch intent/outbox buffers owned by Runtime.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Publishes intents after Workers command/result contract lock.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers execution and Factory Runtime Instance Host.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Intent lifecycle is Runtime-local; Workers owns execution attempts.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Duplicate/correlated-result conflicts recover inside Runtime outbox policy.

ownerRationales.authority: Construct inert instances from lease/start data and manage run handle lifecycle.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Live instance handles and runtime-owned artifact closure metadata.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Start/stop/pause/resume/replace/recover for one Runtime instance.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions placement/lease commands and Orchestration.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Instance handle mutations stay in Runtime; Session desired lifecycle stays in Sessions.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Replacement and recovery failures remain Runtime instance faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Select orchestration kind, compile/validate/preview/execute/resume strategy semantics, encode checkpoints.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Compiled orchestration strategy state for the active instance.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Execute/resume under Instance Host; Petri/JavaScript are internal variants.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Runtime root, Definition semantic validation callers via Runtime root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Strategy execution shares Runtime instance transaction; authored Factory config remains Definitions.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Strategy validation and execution faults normalize through Runtime orchestration.

ownerRationales.authority: Session identity, desired lifecycle, placement, recovery, discovery, invocation coordination, and session response streams.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Live session registry, session control store, and session-owned persistence coordination (canonical history delegated to Recordings).
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Owns desired lifecycle reconcile, live selection/activation, and durable start/resume/control.
ownerRationales.consumers: Transports, Factory Runtime, Work, Workers, Provider Sessions, Models, Visualization, Recordings.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Session aggregate mutations are Sessions-local; peer services are commanded through roots.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Placement/activation conflicts, durable control failures, and timeout/cancellation are Sessions recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Durable start/resume/control/inspection and session-owned persistence coordination.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Session durable execution identity/persistence handles; delegates canonical history/artifacts to Recordings.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Durable control lifecycle for a session.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions root, Live Runtime, Recordings root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Session persistence coordination is Sessions-local; ledger append is Recordings command.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Durable control and resume conflicts recover in Durable Execution.

ownerRationales.authority: Normalize/discover targets, derive logical keys, resolve folders, registry-aware identity lookup.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Logical session keys and folder/identity resolution metadata.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Identity resolution is request-driven under Sessions.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions root and nested Live Runtime/Durable Execution.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Identity derivation shares Sessions aggregate authority.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Ambiguous/missing identity targets are Sessions identity failures.

ownerRationales.authority: Resolve invocation input, command Work, observe completion, enforce timeout/cancellation, record telemetry.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Per-session invocation observation state.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Timeout/cancellation lifecycle for one session invocation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Work root, Factory Sessions root, Recordings telemetry consumers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Invocation coordination is Sessions-local; Work admission/state are Work commands.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Timeouts and cancellations are Sessions invocation recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Open/list/get/snapshot/pause/resume/close; sole owner of live registry, selection, activation lock, cleanup.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Live session registry and mutable live-runtime aggregate.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Live activation lock and cleanup lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions root, Runtime Opening, Durable Execution, Response Stream.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Live registry mutations are exclusive to Live Runtime inside Sessions.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Activation races and cleanup failures recover under Live Runtime.

ownerRationales.authority: Allocate session event stores, publish/complete, filter subscriptions, enforce retention/backpressure, track cursors.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Ephemeral session response-event stores and cursors.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Publish/complete and subscription lifecycle for a session.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions root, transports/Visualization presentation consumers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Response-store mutations are Sessions-local; canonical Factory events belong to Recordings.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Backpressure/drop and retention faults are Response Stream recovery policy.

ownerRationales.authority: Coordinate peer root services and return a lifecycle plan without importing peer implementations.
ownerRationales.stateStore: No independent datastore; produces lifecycle plan over already-constructed roles.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Opening/binding lifecycle after root binding contract stabilizes.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions root and peer service roots (Definitions, Runtime, Workers, Models, Recordings).
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Does not own peer transactions; only plans Sessions-owned activation steps.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Binding/plan failures surface as Sessions opening faults without peer downcasts.

ownerRationales.authority: Request-activated visualization lifecycle, live projection, response/event presentation, queues, backpressure, final-write coordination.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Visualization cursors, output queues, and presentation state for an activated request.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Inert by default; Start/Stop/Wait/cleanup only when request parameters activate it.
ownerRationales.consumers: Transports (parameters/codecs/sinks), Recordings query/subscription, sanitized Runtime observations.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Activation and presentation mutations are Visualization-local; Recordings/Runtime remain peer roots.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Backpressure drops, activation failures, and drain errors are Visualization recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Interpret approved request options, bind session/runtime, own Start/Stop/Wait/cleanup.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Activation binding state for the request.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Request-driven visualization lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Visualization root and transport adapters.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Activation state is Visualization-local.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Failed binds and unclean shutdowns are activation recovery faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Retain cursor/events, subscribe retained-then-live, consume Runtime observations and Recordings queries, emit View.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Live view cursor/event retention owned by Visualization.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Subscription lifecycle under activation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Recordings projection/query root and Runtime observation contract.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: View projection state is Visualization-local; canonical projections stay in Recordings.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Reconnect/gap handling follows Visualization cursor policy.

ownerRationales.authority: Best-effort/lossless queues, bounded drop/backpressure, exclusive final writes, drain.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Output queues and presentation buffers.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Queue drain lifecycle tied to activation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Transport sinks/codecs and Visualization root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Queue mutations are Visualization-local.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Drop/backpressure and final-write conflicts are presentation recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Opaque runtime scopes, model catalog, assets, supervised hosting/readiness, nested leases, and inference.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Model catalog/readiness store, asset cache layout, supervised runtime slots and leases.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Process-scoped service is inert until commanded; hosts manage unload/eviction/shutdown.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers, Factory Sessions, Operator Settings, Models HTTP/CLI adapters.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Catalog/assets/host/lease/inference share Models process scope; peers never see host internals.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Pull/host/lease/inference failures normalize at Models root with typed readiness/availability facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Resolve source/cache layout, pull, verify, classify, remove, and report immutable asset readiness.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Asset cache and verification metadata.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Pull/remove operations; no independent public lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Models Catalog/Inference via Models root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Asset mutations are Models-local.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Pull/verify failures classify as Models asset readiness faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Canonical model identity, configured operation/binding discovery, source metadata, list/get, readiness projection.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Model catalog and configured binding metadata.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Catalog queries/commands; readiness projection without hosting.
ownerRationales.consumers: Models root consumers including Workers and direct `you models` flows.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Catalog identity is Models-local; Providers owns external provider IDs.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Unknown model/operation lookups are Catalog rejection facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Resolve scoped model operation, acquire lease, load/reuse handle, invoke, release, normalize artifacts/failures.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Invocation-time handle/lease usage over Runtime Host slots.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Acquire/release around one inference operation.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers and Models transports via Models root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Inference does not own catalog/host stores; it uses Host leases transactionally for one call.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Invocation and artifact-export failures normalize through Inference.

ownerRationales.authority: Own supervised runtime slots, health/readiness, handle reuse, idle unload, resource-pressure eviction, shutdown.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Supervised process/runtime slot registry.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Host supervision lifecycle including idle unload and shutdown.
ownerRationales.consumers: Models Inference and Leases nested subservice.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Slot mutations are exclusive to Runtime Host (+ nested Leases).
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Eviction and supervision faults recover inside Runtime Host.

ownerRationales.authority: Capacity reservation, holder identity, acquisition/release/expiry, contention over Host-owned slots.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Lease records over Runtime Host slots.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Lease acquire/release/expiry lifecycle nested under Host.
ownerRationales.consumers: Models Inference via Runtime Host.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Leases share Host atomic capacity invariant; not a sibling top-level cut.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Contention/expiry failures are lease recovery facts under Host.

ownerRationales.authority: Open/close opaque scopes for detached Factory-session model configuration without constructing another Service.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Scope binding registry rejecting stale/foreign references.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Open/close scope lifecycle; does not construct hosts/pullers.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions and Models root callers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Scope registry is Models-local and process-scoped.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Stale/foreign scope references are typed scope faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Operator-owned configuration, backend identity, defaults, provider/worker presets, precedence, semantic updates, atomic persistence.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Authoritative operator settings document store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Load/update/persist on command; no autonomous reconciler.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions, Workers, Models, System Bootstrap, CLI, Wire.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Document and resolution share one atomic operator document aggregate.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Malformed/unsupported/conflict/persistence failures are Operator Settings typed facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Load, decode, normalize, validate, identity/version, inventory, semantic update, and atomically persist the operator document.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Operator settings document files/store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Atomic persist lifecycle for document updates.
ownerRationales.consumers: Operator Settings Resolution and root consumers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Document writes are the Operator Settings transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Decode/validation/persist failures stay on Document.

ownerRationales.authority: Apply backend scope, environment, defaults, presets, and invocation overrides into an immutable effective selection.
ownerRationales.stateStore: No independent store; reads Document and environment/effect ports.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Pure resolution on command.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers/Models/Sessions via Operator Settings root; may query Providers for canonical IDs.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Resolution does not mutate Document; callers persist via Document commands.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Conflict/unsupported override failures are Resolution facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Secure resolution and read-only inspection of provider-owned persisted session artifacts, transcripts, reasoning, tools, parse errors, and usage.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Resolved provider-session and transcript projections; no provider execution store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Read-only resolve/inspect lifecycle; no execution daemon.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions, Workers (carry SessionRef), HTTP Provider Sessions adapters.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Readers share Provider Sessions root transaction for one SessionRef resolve; Providers owns SessionRef minting.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Secure path/parse failures and unknown SessionRef errors are Provider Sessions facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Secure JSONL rollout discovery, timestamped layouts, symlink containment, native parsing, normalized detail projection.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Codex transcript discovery/projection state for a resolve.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Read-only resolve path for Codex SessionRefs.
ownerRationales.consumers: Provider Sessions root registry.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Reader-local parse projection; no cross-owner writes.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Symlink/path and parse errors normalize through Codex Reader.

ownerRationales.authority: Cursor directory/store resolution, SQLite access, protobuf/blob decoding, transcript reconstruction, usage projection.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Cursor store resolution/projection state for a resolve.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Read-only resolve path for Cursor SessionRefs.
ownerRationales.consumers: Provider Sessions root registry.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Reader-local decode projection; no provider execution.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Store/decode failures normalize through Cursor Reader.

ownerRationales.authority: Provider protocol, catalog/enumeration, identity and selection, availability/capabilities, SessionRef identity, native adapters, and one normalized execution attempt.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Provider catalog descriptors and availability/capability snapshots; execution is attempt-scoped.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Catalog refresh and one-shot Execute attempts; no Work retry policy.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers (selection/retry), Operator Settings (validation), transports (`you providers list`), Provider Sessions (SessionRef).
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Provider protocol, selection, session identity, adapter choice, and one Execute attempt are Providers-local; Workers owns dispatch retry/scheduling.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Availability/prerequisite and native execution failures classify at Providers; Workers decides retry.

ownerRationales.authority: Canonical provider IDs/aliases, deterministic list/get, metadata, availability/prerequisite probes, capability snapshots.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Provider catalog and probe snapshots.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: List/get/refresh on command.
ownerRationales.consumers: Providers root, Operator Settings validation, Workers selection data.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Catalog mutations/snapshots are Providers-local.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Probe and unknown-ID failures are Catalog facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Own provider protocol selection, native adapter choice, stream decode, progress, diagnostics, optional SessionRef, and one normalized provider attempt.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Attempt-scoped execution state; no durable Work store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: One Execute attempt lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers via Providers root; Provider Sessions resolves emitted SessionRef.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Provider selection, session identity, adapter execution, and the attempt boundary are Providers-local; Workers owns when to invoke and any multi-attempt policy.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Native adapter and failure-normalization faults are Execution facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Canonical event acceptance, ordering, replay, recording lifecycle, artifacts/export, subscriptions, and query projections.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Canonical session event store, artifact store, and projection store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Recorder capture/flush lifecycle plus replay/delivery; projections reduce canonical facts.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions, Factory Runtime, Workers, Visualization, HTTP/CLI dashboard/history consumers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Ledger append/projection rebuild share Recordings canonical identity; peers emit facts, they do not write the ledger.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Gap/cursor/retention, replay divergence, and recorder crash/finalization are Recordings recovery concerns.

ownerRationales.authority: Persist replay artifacts and build/validate/decode/atomically export privacy-bounded portable recordings.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Artifact store and portable export packages.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Export/materialize on command; atomic write policy.
ownerRationales.consumers: Recordings Replay and public export consumers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Artifact writes are Recordings-local and privacy-bounded.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Export validation and atomic-write failures are Artifacts/Export faults.

ownerRationales.authority: Validate, sequence, idempotently append, retain, and subscribe to canonical Factory events.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Canonical session event store with cursor/gap/retention policy.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Append/subscribe lifecycle for canonical facts.
ownerRationales.consumers: Runtime/Workers/Sessions emitters and Projection/Replay consumers via Recordings root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Ledger append is the Recordings source-of-truth transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Idempotency, gap, and retention conflicts recover in Canonical Ledger.

ownerRationales.authority: Deterministically reduce canonical events into world-state and customer/dashboard views; validate reconnect projections.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Projection store derived from canonical ledger.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Projection rebuild/query lifecycle private to Recordings.
ownerRationales.consumers: Visualization, Sessions, dashboard transports via Recordings root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Projection rebuild is Recordings-local; not a separate deployable in this program.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Reconnect/projection divergence faults are Projection/Query recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Select session recording target, capture events, periodic/final flush, error accumulation, crash/finalization.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Recorder target and flush state for a session recording.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Capture/flush/finalization lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Sessions/Runtime emitters via Recordings root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Recorder state is Recordings-local around canonical append.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Crash/final flush failures recover in Recording Lifecycle.

ownerRationales.authority: Load/validate/hydrate historical recordings, deterministic clock, replay plans/hooks, delivery timing, divergence detection.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Historical recording loads and replay plan handles.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Replay delivery lifecycle with deterministic timing.
ownerRationales.consumers: Dashboard/CLI replay consumers and Artifacts/Export.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Replay plans are Recordings-owned; peers do not import replay implementations.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Divergence and hydrate failures are Replay recovery facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Customer-invoked initialization workflow coordinating Operator Settings and Factory Definition without owning their stores.
ownerRationales.stateStore: No independent datastore; observes initialization outcome only.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Single Initialize command with idempotent/partial-failure reporting.
ownerRationales.consumers: CLI/HTTP `you init` adapters; commands Operator Settings and Factory Definitions roots.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Cross-owner ordering only; Settings and Definitions retain their own transactions/rollback.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Partial failure/rollback reporting is Bootstrap-owned without absorbing peer stores.

ownerRationales.authority: Factory-configured outbound webhook subscriptions, canonical event filtering, signed delivery attempts, bounded retry/backoff, and session-owned dead-letter diagnostics; Recordings remains the event authority.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Process-local endpoint delivery state and session-owned dead-letter JSONL; no canonical Factory state.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Wire constructs the service once; Factory Sessions start and stop session-scoped endpoint subscribers and delivery workers.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Definitions configuration, Recordings canonical events, platform HTTP/clock/logging effects, and external webhook receivers.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Webhook delivery, retry, and dead-letter state remain Webhooks-local; canonical events are read-only input and terminal records use an injected runtime-storage effect.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Secret, receiver, retry, cancellation, and dead-letter failures are structured Webhooks diagnostics and never mutate or block Factory Session or Work state.

ownerRationales.authority: Work Request admission, secure content staging/materialization, invocation/return policy, lineage, state commands, and detached queries.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Work and dispatch store plus staged content references.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Admission and state commands; no scheduling daemon (Automations owns triggers).
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations, Factory Runtime, Factory Sessions, Workers, Recordings, Definitions, transports.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Admission/content/state share Work identity and mutation invariants.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Acceptance/rejection, staging/materialization, and state-command failures are Work facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Normalize, validate, deduplicate, authorize, and accept Work Requests; emit acceptance/rejection facts.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Accepted Work Request records in Work store.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Admission is command-driven.
ownerRationales.consumers: Automations and public protocols via Work root; Runtime consumes admitted Work.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Acceptance is the Work intake transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Validation/authorization rejections are Admission facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Resolve staged/local/remote/data-URL content with cache, SSRF, size, cleanup, and cancellation policy.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Materialization cache and resolved content handles.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Resolve/cleanup lifecycle for content fetches.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers and Work root consumers needing immutable content.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Materialization policy is Work-local; Workers do not import Work modules.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: SSRF/size/cancellation failures are Materialization facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Securely persist submitted content, issue/verify opaque references, enforce expiry and owned-path policy.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Staged content reference store and owned paths.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Stage/expire/cleanup lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Work Admission and Materialization via Work root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Staging writes share Work content transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Expiry and path-policy violations are Staging facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Adapt Factory Sessions root for submit/move/read snapshot operations and detached list/get/move results.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Detached Work query/projection results over Work store; never exposes Runtime/Petri state.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Read/move commands without peer store access.
ownerRationales.consumers: Transports and peer services via Work root; may query Sessions/Recordings roots.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: State Access does not write Sessions/Recordings stores.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Not-found and move conflicts are State Access facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Owns the live Worker Session lifecycle for one Factory dispatch: session identity, start/control, retained observation, terminal outcome, publication, and dispatch association.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Process-local Worker Session records and retained observations backed by the Events stream; durable Factory history remains owned by Recordings.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Wire constructs the service once; start, control, publish, read, stream, and terminalization operations share the Worker Session lifecycle and close with the process.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers dispatch, Factory Sessions, Events, Chat Sessions response bridging, and CLI/HTTP Worker Session transports.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Worker Session lifecycle and publication state are session-local; Workers decides when a request-scoped attempt runs while Worker Sessions records and exposes its observable session.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Invalid lifecycle transitions, stale controls, missing sessions, publication conflicts, retention gaps, and terminalization failures remain typed Worker Session facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Request-scoped runner selection/assembly, workstation behavior, capacity, dispatch execution policy, retry, and Work results; Providers owns provider protocol and one native attempt.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Worker registry/execution store and immutable runtime assembly artifacts.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Dispatch execution and runner lifecycles; Providers owns native provider attempts.
ownerRationales.consumers: Factory Runtime dispatch, Factory Sessions, Models, Providers, Work, Recordings.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Execution/retry policy is Workers-local; Providers Execute is one attempt command.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Dispatch/retry/cancellation failures normalize as Workers execution facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Common private Runner contract/registry implemented by agent/script/inference/hosted runners.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Runner registry identities/capabilities; execution state lives in runner implementations.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Registry selection for one dispatch; runners own attempt execution.
ownerRationales.consumers: Runtime Assembly and Workstation Execution.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Registry is Workers-private; provider adapters live under Providers.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Unknown runner/capability mismatches are registry rejection facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Implement Runner for agent harness/tools, retries, stop tokens, decision envelopes, terminal results.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Agent attempt execution state under Workers.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Agent runner attempt lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers Runner registry; may command Providers/Models through Workers policy.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Agent attempt is Workers-local; Providers owns native provider attempt details.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Harness/retry/stop-token failures are Agent Runner facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Implement Runner for hosted execution request/result, remote lifecycle observation, cancellation, normalized outcome.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Hosted execution attempt state under Workers.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Hosted runner attempt lifecycle (not hosted polling).
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers Runner registry; Automations Hosted Sources remain separate.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Hosted Work execution is Workers-local; source polling is Automations.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Remote lifecycle/cancellation failures are Hosted Runner facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Implement a request-scoped Runner for model binding/readiness, provider invocation through Providers, and output mapping; it does not own provider protocol, selection, session, adapter, or native execution behavior.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Inference runner attempt state under Workers.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Request-scoped worker attempt lifecycle coordinating Models and one Providers attempt.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers Runner registry, Models Inference, and Providers root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Workers decides when and which worker attempt runs; Providers owns provider protocol, selection, session, adapter, and one native attempt while Models owns local model readiness/inference.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Binding/readiness/output-mapping failures are Inference Runner facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Implement Runner for script command policy, process execution, progress/events, timeout, and result.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Script attempt execution state under Workers.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Script runner attempt lifecycle.
ownerRationales.consumers: Workers Runner registry.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Script attempt is Workers-local.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Timeout/process failures are Script Runner facts.

ownerRationales.authority: Context/environment, interpolation, behavior routing, dispatch, and final output.
ownerRationales.stateStore: Workstation execution context for a dispatch.
ownerRationales.lifecycle: Dispatch execution path lifecycle under Workers.
ownerRationales.consumers: Runner registry and Factory Runtime dispatch consumers via Workers root.
ownerRationales.transactionBoundary: Workstation execution shares Workers dispatch transaction.
ownerRationales.failureRecovery: Routing/dispatch failures are Workstation Execution facts.

responsibilityClusters.name: Runner contract and registry mechanics
responsibilityClusters.note: Private Workers registry backing runner subservices; not a separate product owner.

namedOwnerConfirmations.note: Retain top-level visualization; nested activation, live view, and presentation maps are committed. Sink/codec adapters stay as responsibility clusters, not alternate owners.
Retain one Operator Settings owner; provider settings remain Document/Resolution content, not a competing top-level Provider Settings or Providers catalog service.
Retain read-only Provider Sessions with Codex/Cursor reader nested maps. Does not enumerate or execute providers.

residualPackageRules.note: Agy/PTY adapter packages move into Providers native adapters under the singular Providers root.

namedOwnerConfirmations.note: Add Providers as the singular catalog+execution owner. Capabilities remain Catalog queries; native adapters remain responsibility clusters—not competing provider catalog/execution top-level abstractions.
Retain one Recordings family. Projection/Replay/Artifacts stay nested; they are not promoted to competing top-level owners in this program.
Retain System Bootstrap with no nested subservice. Legacy migration remains a deletion-only responsibility cluster, not a discovery-open nested service.

publicSurfaces.note: Hosted poller/source behavior coverage under Workers hosted_logic moves with Automation Hosted Sources; Workers retains hosted runner execution tests only.
Provider enumeration/modelProvider CLI docs burn down to Providers Catalog; Workers docs retain selection/retry/runner policy only.
you providers list and provider-facing CLI adapters consume Providers Catalog as the durable owner.
OpenAPI provider identity/capability fields stay transport-shaped but durable domain owner is Providers.
MCP Factory Session tools adapt Factory Sessions; they are not Workers-owned provider surfaces.
Replay and artifact reconstruction remain Recordings-owned public surfaces through recordings/wire after DEL-REC removed the transitional replay/ shim.
